def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v0`."""
    a1 = parameters[0]
    a2 = parameters[1]
    a3 = parameters[2]
    a4 = parameters[3]
    a5 = parameters[4]
    a6 = parameters[5]
    a7 = parameters[6]
    a8 = parameters[7]
    a9 = parameters[8]
    a10 = parameters[9]
    a11 = parameters[10]
    a12 = parameters[11]
    
    m = log10(np.abs(gate_voltage_abs / a1) * np.abs(drain_voltage_abs / a2))
    n = a3 + a4 * gate_voltage_abs + a5 * drain_voltage_abs
    p = a6 + a7 * gate_voltage_abs + a8 * drain_voltage_abs
    q = a9 + a10 * gate_voltage_abs + a11 * drain_voltage_abs
    r = a12 * gate_voltage_abs
    
    return m * n * p * q * r
